summary: Verified the Master Admin MFA console Regenerate-backup-codes UI end-to-end. Enrolled the master admin via homepage Sign In modal -> /login forced enrolment (gx-login-enrol-form) using a live TOTP from gx-login-enrol-secret, saved backup codes and continued to /master-admin. Navigated to /master-admin?section=my-security -> MFA panel (my-mfa-panel) showed Active badge (my-mfa-enabled-badge) and 'Regenerate backup codes' button (my-mfa-regen-btn). Clicked regen -> my-mfa-regen-code appeared. Entered 000000 -> my-mfa-regen-error shown ('Invalid authenticator code.') and NO backup codes rendered. Waited a full 30s window, entered a fresh live TOTP -> my-mfa-backup-codes panel rendered with exactly 10 NEW hex codes and a 'New backup codes generated' toast. my-mfa-done-btn was disabled until my-mfa-saved-check was ticked, then enabled. Backend enforcement flag preserved (ENFORCE_MASTER_ADMIN_MFA=true). Final cleanup: db.user_mfa cleared; POST /api/auth/login returns {requires_mfa_enrolment:true}.
critical_code_review_comments: MyMfaPanel.js: the low-backup-codes warning (my-mfa-lowcodes-warning) is only rendered when status.backup_codes_remaining <= 3 — behaviour unverified in this run because a fresh enrolment mints 10 codes; consider a backend-driven fixture or unit test that stubs status to trigger the warning path.
seed_data_creation: None. Post-test cleanup deleted user_mfa docs so admin is un-enrolled again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ENFORCE_MASTER_ADMIN_MFA=true, admin NOT enrolled (verified). Regen flow works. Enrol/regen TOTP flow is timing-sensitive: replay protection rejects the same code twice, so after the enrol code, wait for the next 30s TOTP window before submitting the regen code (test did this and it worked). The low-codes warning (my-mfa-lowcodes-warning) path was not exercised (requires <=3 backup codes remaining).
